name: Can I create one PDF per recipient from a list of names?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Choose Personalized PDF copies in Quick Edit PDF before opening a file. Paste the names or import an Excel or CSV list, mark where the name goes, then download the PDFs as a ZIP. To add a watermark as well, turn on Also add a watermark to each copy: write {name} in its text, such as Copy for {name}, and each copy gets its recipient's name there too. Try an example to follow the same steps with a sample PDF and two fictional recipients.

name: Is my PDF uploaded anywhere to edit it?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The whole process — opening the PDF, replacing the edited lines and checking the result — runs entirely in your browser. Your document never leaves your device.

name: Can I add new paragraphs or delete a table row?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not with this tool — Quick Edit PDF is built for retyping existing text in place, not restructuring a document. If you need to add or remove content, convert to Word with PDF to Word, make the full edit there, then convert back to PDF.

name: Why did it say my PDF can't be edited here?

acceptedAnswer.text: A file with text opens on its own pages, where you edit it in place. A scan has no text to change; fillable forms and signed PDFs aren't edited in place. The previous editor, which rebuilds the document as editable text, first checks how cleanly your PDF's structure converts — scanned documents, unusual layouts or damaged text extraction can score too low to edit safely, and then it suggests the full PDF to Word converter instead.

name: Does editing change the formatting of the rest of the document?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Only the text of the lines you retype changes: their old text is removed and the new text is written in the same place. Pictures, other lines and other pages stay as they were, and every changed page is read back before you download it.

name: Does PDFree store or log my files after processing?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. PDFree runs entirely in your browser — there is no backend server that receives your files. Because nothing is uploaded, nothing can be stored, logged, or retained. Your document exists only in your browser's memory for the duration of the session and is cleared when you close the tab.

name: Is this a free PDF editor with no sign up?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. PDFree is completely free — no sign up, no account, no installation. Open the tool, load your PDF, click the text you want to fix, and download the result.
